title: Apply epic-54v final-review findings (2 should-fix, 4 nits)
description:
Read-only final review approved the epic with findings to fix now. Apply exactly these, nothing else:
1. Channel.Send contract (internal/operator/channel.go): define Send text as PLAIN TEXT at the interface; the Telegram implementation must HTML-escape it before sending (parse_mode stays HTML internally). Update the Telegram impl + tests; callers stay channel-neutral. (Supersedes the earlier 'Send carries intentional markup' decision.)
2. Pairing offset confirm (cmd/tk/cmd/channel.go + telegram client): after a successful /start match, issue one short GetUpdates with the advanced offset so Telegram marks the pairing update confirmed and a later run's poll does not replay it. Test: fakebot asserts the confirming offset call.
3. Chat filter (internal/operator/telegram/channel.go handleMessage): drop messages whose ChatID differs from the paired chat id; test with a bound-user message from a different chat.
4. internal/operator/mapping.go: remove speculative exports — drop unused PublicIdentity/OperatorMapping aliases, change ResolveOperator from variadic emulation to the plain two-arg signature its callers use.
5. cmd/tk/cmd/channel.go token prompt: use golang.org/x/term ReadPassword when stdin is a TTY (no echo); keep the current bufio path when not a TTY so tests keep working.
6. Fix stale doc comment on pairWhenPrompted (channel_test.go ~line 87) mentioning a nonexistent 'prefix' parameter.
Run gofmt; keep the whole repo green.
